title: Lesson 1 Quiz: What DeFi Actually Is (and Isn't)

questions.text: Which risk is eliminated by using DeFi instead of a centralized bank?
questions.explanation: DeFi removes the need to trust a custodian, eliminating counterparty risk.

questions.text: True or false: In DeFi, you keep control of your private keys when you connect a self-custody wallet.
questions.explanation: DeFi requires you to manage your own keys, giving you direct control.
